messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@vectorlytics.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:12:00Z
Subject: POC stress window - urgent credit buffer request

Hey Mina,

Quick ask — we're lined up to run a 48h latency/throughput soak this next week (Thursday-Friday) to validate p95/p99 under realistic traffic. Our infra team discovered we will exhaust the trial allowance before the run completes unless we get an emergency top-up.

Can Redwood provide a one-time 150k-token sandbox credit bump (or equivalent $) scoped to this run? We'll limit inference to the pinned model you already provisioned and share the post-run latency breakdown. This is critical for our internal sign-off.

Attachments: Vectorlytics_48h_test_plan.pdf (test steps + expected load)

Appreciate a quick reply — we need to lock the schedule by EOD tomorrow.

— Alex
Head of Platform, Vectorlytics
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@vectorlytics.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC stress window - urgent credit buffer request

Alex — thanks for the context and the test plan. Quick clarifying questions before I push this to approvals:

- Is the request 150k tokens total or 150k tokens/day?
- Will Vectorlytics run any large-batch reranking jobs or only standard generation over short sequences?
- Do you want the credit scoped to this account + model only (recommended) or broad sandbox access?

Karthik — can you review the attached test plan and confirm expected resource profile and whether 150k tokens is a reasonable estimate for a 48h soak? If we need to adjust, flag with a quick range so I can put an accurate ask to finance.

If we can scope and confirm the numbers I can get a provisional top-up approved for this POC.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex@vectorlytics.io>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: POC stress window - urgent credit buffer request

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 09:15 Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — can you review the attached test plan and confirm expected resource profile...

Quick read-through — Vectorlytics will mostly hit short-gen paths with sequence lengths around 128 tokens, occasional longer prompts (<=512) for a small subset of flows. No heavy reranking or huge batch requests called out in the plan.

Ballpark: 150k tokens total should be sufficient if traffic is steady and mostly short sequences; if they run high-concurrency bursts we could see 180–200k. Recommend: approve 175k tokens scoped to the Vectorlytics POC and pin model x-redwood-1 to prevent fallback to broader variants.

I'll stay on watch during the run and pull logs if we see token consumption ramping unexpectedly.

— Karthik
Director, Inference Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T14:22:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Vectorlytics POC - emergency buffer for 48h latency soak (approval request)

Marissa — forwarding Vectorlytics' ask. Karthik recommends a one-time 175k-token scoped credit (pin to model x-redwood-1) to get them through a 48h latency/throughput validation. They’ll run Thursday-Friday and will share post-run latency p50/p95/p99 and token breakdown.

Can finance approve a one-off sandbox allowance and confirm it won't be charged to the customer? We typically treat small POC top-ups as credits against marketing/sales sandbox budget. If you need a SoW sign-off I'll attach the SOW draft (see SoW_Vectorlytics_draft_v2.docx).

Quick approval would be ideal — they need to lock the test by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks — Mina
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@vectorlytics.io>
Date: 2026-11-27T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vectorlytics POC - emergency buffer for 48h latency soak (approval request)

Mina / team — approved.

Finance will provision a one-time 175,000-token sandbox credit to Vectorlytics (VL-349), scoped to account vectorlytics@redwood-sandbox and pinned to model x-redwood-1. This will be recorded against the POC marketing allowance (cost center MKT-POC-2026).

I've attached the SoW draft for your records and included the ticket ID for tracking: FIN-TOPUP-8712. Please note this top-up is non-billable; if usage exceeds the 175k tokens we'll auto-notify Mina and Vectorlytics to discuss incremental charges.

Attachments: SoW_Vectorlytics_draft_v2.docx

Alex — good luck with the soak. Ping Karthik if you want us to enable additional observability hooks (per-route latency tracing) during the window.

— Marissa Cole
